title: Dimensional Holiday
description: A whole new meaning to world generation using existing biomes in minecraft vanilla to generate in ways unimagined
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VqHS9mdUw_g" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>Ever wondered how crazy terrain generation could get? Dimensional Holidays pushes minecraft's world generation to the limit! With nether and end biomes in the overworld, aswell as underground biomes

Dimensional Holiday uses a checkerboard pattern to generate patches of biomes endlessly! from normal overworld biomes to even outer dimensional biomes

Dimensional Holiday is also a great way to discover Nether and End Structures with a much friendlier environment

Dimensional Holiday : Chaos Edition (Original) --> The original amazing experience of Dimensional Holidays! full of structures and awe
